summary: Iteration 2 testing (Kill Timeline, Ship Breakdown, Recent Roams). 16/16 backend pytest tests pass and full frontend Playwright flow passes: timeline panel + toggle, ships tab with Ship Classes Killed + Juiciest Targets (juicy focus does not crash), Recent Roams open/close/pick, load-by-id, killmails click-to-filter, clear filter, members. Regression flows intact.

issues: recharts logs a brief 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warning on first mount and after toggling show/hide before container measures. Cosmetic only; chart renders correctly. Could be silenced by giving the ResponsiveContainer an explicit min-height.

critical_code_review_comments: Timeline.jsx: recharts ResponsiveContainer briefly measures to -1 on first paint (see console warnings). Wrap in a fixed-height div (e.g. h-40) or add minHeight to ResponsiveContainer to eliminate the warning.
server.py /reports/recent has no in-memory caching; every call proxies i.npsi.rocks. Consider a short TTL cache (30-60s) to protect the upstream and improve latency for the Recent Roams dropdown.
shipBreakdown tie-breaks on ISK desc which is sensible, but ties on both would be non-deterministic across runs; acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: None. Live NPSI API used (report 622 confirmed present in /reports/recent at test time).
